voices.name: Alok K – Calming Late Night Storyteller
voices.description: Alok K delivers a deep, bassy, and thoughtful delivery crafted for late-night listening. His conversational storytelling style feels intimate and immersive, making every line land with emotion and presence. Ideal for late-night RJ shows, storytelling podcasts, relationship stories, confessions, poetry, and long-form narratives. Perfect for night-time radio, podcasts, YouTube storytelling channels, and audio content designed for quiet, after-hours listening.

voices.name: Alok K - Late Night Storyteller: Engaging & Expressive
voices.description: Alok K’s voice is tailored for late-night radio storytelling, romantic dedications, or reflective talk segments. With his engaging tone, expressive delivery, and calm pacing, he creates an immersive listener experience perfect for FM-style radio shows, sleep podcasts, love letter narrations, and audio journaling. Alok’s RJ voice blends warmth and intimacy, ideal for platforms that want to build a personal listener connection.

voices.name: Alok K – Deep, Suspenseful & Intense for Thrillers & Stories
voices.description: Alok K’s deep, deliberate pacing and intense delivery make him ideal for suspenseful storytelling and slow-burn narratives. His voice builds anticipation and tension gradually, perfect for horror podcasts, thriller audiobooks, or dramatic OTT content. He can use his captivating style to hold listener attention till the last word.

voices.name: Alok - Balanced, Warm and Articulate
voices.description:
A balanced & articulate voice designed for trust-building and smooth issue resolution.

Alok brings a professional yet warm tone that is ideal for formal support conversations.

Perfectly suited for customer care flows, onboarding journeys, escalation handling, and product explanations. Best used on Customer engagement platforms, fintech, and e-commerce support automation.

voices.name: Alok - Professional Bank Advisor
voices.description:
A smooth, confident male voice that strikes the perfect balance between being friendly and highly professional.

Alok K speaks with clarity, steadiness, and an authentic tone that feels human, not robotic — making customers feel heard while maintaining a high standard of service.

Ideal for IVR flows, virtual assistants, and enterprise-grade platforms across banking, telecom, healthcare, and e-commerce — including Twilio, Zoho, Genesys, and Amazon Connect.

voices.name: Alok - Deep and Suspenseful
voices.description:
A deep, cinematic voice that draws listeners into thrilling narratives, mysteries, and dark revelations.

Alok K’s delivery is intense yet composed—perfect for true crime podcasts, suspense narrations, dramatic documentaries, and mystery shorts. His tone builds tension with every pause, making him ideal for YouTube thrillers, OTT trailers, audio series, and narrative-driven social content. Whether it’s a secret unfolding or a chilling twist, Alok’s voice keeps audiences hooked.

voices.name: Alon - Deep, Resonant and Calming
voices.description: A young male with a deep and gentle resonant voice with a slight Asian accent. For narration and story telling.

voices.name: Alee - Youthful, Steady, and Breathy
voices.description: The voice of alee, AKA The Amazing Aloo. Voice that is engaging and inviting. With a smooth tone, I make stories enjoyable to listen to. I love bringing characters to life and narrating a variety of tales.
